prompt: Our Talend job runs fine in Studio but when ops run the exported zip on the Linux server it dies with 'Exception in component tMap_2 (ORDERS_LOAD) java.lang.NullPointerException' and sometimes 'java.lang.ClassCastException: java.lang.Long cannot be cast to java.lang.Integer' in tJava_1. Also the context values seem wrong on the server. They run it with ./ORDERS_LOAD_run.sh --context_param DB_HOST=prod-db. What's going on and how do we fix each problem?
assertions: Explains the tMap NullPointerException as null data hitting a non-nullable (primitive) column or a null-dereferencing expression and gives the Nullable/guard fix
Explains the ClassCastException as a wrong cast on a globalMap value and names the correct cast approach
Points out that without --context=<ContextName> the Default context runs and that --context_param only overrides individual parameters
Mentions that command-line context values are strings parsed to the declared type and/or implicit context load precedence
Suggests checking the launcher script / contexts folder in the export or the Studio Component/Outline view to confirm variable types
Does not recommend editing generated Java as the primary fix
Gives the exported context file path as <project>/<job>_<ver>/contexts/<ContextName>.properties (no job-name prefix on the file)
Recommends checking the Outline / Component view (or the component's documented return variables) to see the real type of the globalMap value behind the ClassCastException
Links the wrong context to the NPE (a DEV/Default lookup target or empty value can produce the null)
